title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Noise Pollution - NoiseObservation
description: An observation of a noise property made by a noise sensor (edintacus:NoiseObservation, subclass of edint-medio-ambiente's EnvironmentalObservation). Small domain extension adding acoustic-measurement-specific properties on top of the base EnvironmentalObservation pattern.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'NoiseObservation'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

identifier.description: Property. A human-readable code shared by all values calculated for the same measurement session (dct:identifier).

madeBySensor.description: Relationship. The EnvironmentalSensor (noise sensor) that made this observation (sosa:madeBySensor). Inherited from EnvironmentalObservation.

featureOfInterest.description: Relationship. The environmental medium observed, e.g. the acoustic environment (sosa:hasFeatureOfInterest). Inherited from EnvironmentalObservation.

result.description: Property. The simple value of the observation, typically a sound pressure level (sosa:hasSimpleResult). Inherited from EnvironmentalObservation.

unitCode.description: Property. The unit the result is expressed in, e.g. 'DeciB'. Inherited from EnvironmentalObservation.

resultTime.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Instant when the observation result was generated (sosa:resultTime). Inherited from EnvironmentalObservation.

phenomenonTime.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Instant or interval when the observed situation occurred (sosa:phenomenonTime). Inherited from EnvironmentalObservation.

noiseReferenceInterval.description: Property. The measurement period this noise observation refers to (edintacus:noiseReferenceInterval).

noisePonderation.description: Property. The frequency weighting applied to the noise measurement, per ISO 1996 (edintacus:noisePonderation).

noiseEmitterPredominantType.description: Property. The predominant type of noise emitter for this observation (edintacus:noiseEmitterPredominantType).

noiseRateType.description: Property. The type of level statistic for the noise pressure level -- maximum, minimum, or a percentile (P01/P10/P50/P90/P99), from the source's own numeric concept notations '01'/'10'/'50'/'90'/'99' (edintacus:noiseRateType).

noiseTimeConstantType.description: Property. The time constant used for the noise measurement, per IEC 61672 (edintacus:noiseTimeConstantType).
